shortDescription: Detect false-positive tests with the J1-J6 judgment framework
longDescription: falsegreen-skill applies six structural judgments (J1-J6) to each test to determine whether it can actually fail when the code breaks. Covers Python (complete C1-C37 falsegreen catalog), TypeScript, and JavaScript. Works with any OpenAI-compatible API provider: Groq (LLaMA), Together.ai, Ollama, OpenRouter (Qwen), Moonshot Kimi, Mistral.
invocation: Load llm.md as system prompt and paste a test file
